item.title: Platonic Energy Belt
item.description: Black and brown Platonic Energy laser engraved leather belts side by side. A high quality leather belt featuring the five Platonic solids woven into an evolving geometric pattern. Tetrahedrons, cubes, octahedrons, dodecahedrons and icosahedrons flow around the belt, gradually transforming into intricate geometric forms that create a sense of movement and energy. Designed by 1000 Errors.
